full_prompt_en: A square black-and-white pen illustration shows a large bald adult man seated close to the viewer at a table. His head and thick beard fill most of the upper and middle image. Heavy eyebrows arch over wide eyes looking toward the upper right, giving him an unexpectedly curious, gentle expression. An oversized round nose protrudes above a dense dark mustache that blends into a full coarse beard. He wears a plain black V-neck shirt; the solid ink of its broad shoulder and chest contrasts with the much finer marks in his beard. His left forearm crosses the lower edge, and a large hand holds a small light-colored mug by its handle near the lower right. The mug is simple and unornamented. On the tabletop behind it sit a little dish, a bottle, and a boxlike object; their details remain secondary. A framed rectangle or picture edge appears at far left, and a pale round blank shape is clipped near the top right, but the room is only lightly indicated. The background is mostly white paper sprinkled with fine stippling. The man is rendered through delicate short hatches, tiny dots, and a few bold outlines. The beard is especially intricate, with thousands of directional hair marks; the black shirt is a decisive solid mass. A fine rectangular border encloses the picture, leaving a thin white margin outside. There is no speech balloon or readable caption. The scene feels humorous and humane rather than dramatic: the outsized figure, tiny cup, and raised gaze produce a playful mismatch of scale. The drawing is observational yet caricatured, giving physical presence to an ordinary pause at a table.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形黑白钢笔插画把一位体格很大的秃头成年男子放在桌旁，离观者很近。头和浓密胡子占上方与中央大部。浓眉拱起，宽眼望向右上，形成意外好奇而温柔的神情。大而圆的鼻子突出于浓深小胡子之上，小胡子又融入粗密大胡须。他穿纯黑 V 领上衣；肩胸处整块墨黑与胡子里极细笔迹形成对照。左前臂横过下缘，大手在右下握住一只浅色小杯的把手。杯子简单无装饰。其后桌面有小碟、瓶子和方盒状物件，细节都属次要。最左可见相框或画框边，右上裁进一块空白圆形，但房间只被轻描。背景主要是撒着细点的白纸。男子由细短排线、微小点与少数粗轮廓刻画。胡须尤其繁复，由无数顺方向的发丝记号组成；黑上衣则是果断的实色团块。一道细矩形框住画面，外侧留薄白边。没有对话框或可读标题。场景幽默而有人情味，不求戏剧性：巨大的身形、小杯与抬起的眼神造成顽皮尺度错位。画法兼具观察与夸张，给桌旁普通停顿以实在感。
style_prompt_en: The spare pen-and-ink illustration combines generous white paper with a few large solid black areas and richly worked local texture. Fine stippling, short directional hatches, and hairline contour marks model rounded forms, while one dense dark garmentlike shape anchors the lower half. Caricatured proportions enlarge a central mass and reduce small held objects, making a quiet scene gently comic. A thin rectangular border contains the image, and the background remains lightly indicated. Eyes and nose receive precise expressive marks; coarse textures are built patiently from many tiny strokes. The finish is monochrome, slightly grainy, and hand-drawn, with no wash or color fill beyond black ink and paper white. Humor comes from proportion and expression rather than frantic action.
style_prompt_zh: 简练钢笔墨画把宽敞白纸与少数大面积实黑及局部丰厚纹理结合。细点描、顺方向短排线和毛线般轮廓表现圆润形体，一处浓暗衣料般形状压住下半。夸张比例放大中央主体并缩小手持物，让安静场景有温和喜剧感。细矩形边框收住图像，背景仅略作提示。眼与鼻得到精确有表情的笔痕；粗密肌理由许多小线耐心累积。完成度单色、略有颗粒而手绘，除黑墨与纸白外没有色洗或彩填。幽默来自比例和神情，而非忙乱动作。
theme_en: A huge bald bearded man holds a small mug in a simple black ink drawing
theme_zh: 简洁黑白墨画中，秃头大胡子男人握着一只小杯
name: Shel Silverstein
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
